profile.title: Profile
profile.localFirstTrust: Your health records are stored on this device.
profile.showDetailsDescription: Show medication or injection names on the lock screen
profile.showDetailsNote: Symptom values, lab values, and notes are never included in a notification, regardless of this setting.

reminderDefaults.note: Each reminder's timing is set on the medication, injection, or appointment itself. These are the approved defaults:
reminderDefaults.injectionValue: One day before and on the scheduled day

profile.privacyBody: Ankilozanapp stores your health information — symptoms, medications, injections, appointments, and lab results — on this device only. Nothing is sent to a server.
profile.privacyBackup: Your device's own backup (like iCloud) may include this data, the same way it backs up any other app.
profile.deleteDataExplanation: This permanently removes everything you've recorded on this device — symptoms, medications, injections, appointments, and lab results. This cannot be undone.
profile.deleteDataAcknowledge: I understand this cannot be undone
profile.disclaimerBody: Ankilozanapp helps you record and organize information about your symptoms, treatments, and appointments. It does not diagnose, predict, or interpret medical conditions, and it does not recommend treatment. It is not a substitute for professional medical advice — always consult your doctor about your care.
profile.tagline: Remembers what happens between your rheumatology appointments.

nutrition.title: Nutrition
nutrition.subtitle: General information for your everyday eating habits.
nutrition.disclaimer: This information is for general education only and is not a substitute for personal medical or nutritional advice.

item.varietyBody: You can include vegetables, whole grains, and protein sources together in your meals.
item.vegFruitBody: You can add a variety of colors and types of vegetables and fruit to your daily routine.
item.wholeGrainBody: You can try whole-grain options instead of white bread.
item.proteinVarietyBody: You can choose from options like legumes, eggs, fish, and lean meat.
item.waterBody: You can try to drink water at regular intervals throughout the day.
item.mealTimesBody: Planning your meals around similar times each day can help.

breathing.title: Breathing & Posture
breathing.subtitle: Take short breaks during the day to notice your breathing and posture.
breathing.safetyNote: Stop if you feel discomfort, dizziness, or noticeable pain.

practice.calmBreathingBody:
Sit in a comfortable position.
Breathe in and out gently through your nose.
Continue for a few rounds without forcing your breath.
practice.postureAwarenessBody:
Let your shoulders relax.
Find an upright position without pushing your head forward.
Try to hold this position as you breathe.
practice.deskBreakBody:
Take a short break when you've been in the same position for a while.
Stand up or change position comfortably.
